studio.fileInput: Choose a database or working copy

welcome.title: Give old databases a new place to work
welcome.intro: Open an .mdb or .accdb file: Open Database Studio builds an editable working copy from it. The original stays unchanged.
welcome.tablesText: Edit data with type checking, run queries in Access SQL and save results as CSV.
welcome.formsText: Automatic forms, a simple designer and reports with groups and totals, printable as PDF.
welcome.vbaText: Run VBA procedures sandboxed on the working copy: only on request, without files, COM or Shell.
welcome.local: Everything happens locally. Macros, AutoExec and VBA are never run automatically. Save your work as an .sqlite working copy and reopen it later via Open.

ribbon.csvTitle: Current table or query result as CSV
ribbon.externalTitle: External dependencies of the VBA code, and Run what works

build.title: Building working copy
build.intro: {{name}} is being copied into an editable SQLite working copy. The original remains unchanged.
build.cancelHint: Cancelling stops the build immediately. You can then view the database read-only or open it again.

compat.title: Compatibility report
compat.footnote: Read with {{reader}}. The report contains only counts, names and messages, no table data. It describes the read-only path; see the build report for what was copied into the working copy.
